text_en: Hear this, O priests! Give heed, O house of Israel! Listen, O house of the king! For the judgment pertains to you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor,
text_cn: 司祭，你们听信这话！以色列家，留心细听！王室，侧耳倾听！审判是为你们行的，因为你们是米兹帕的圈套，是大博尔山上张开的罗网。

text_en: and a pit dug deep in Shittim; but I will punish all of them.
text_cn: 他们在史廷掘深了陷阱，但是，我却要完全惩治他们。

text_en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, O Ephraim, you have played the whore; Israel is defiled.
text_cn: 我认识厄弗辣因，以色列也瞒不住我：是的，厄弗辣因，你行了淫，以色列玷污了自己。

text_en: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. For the spirit of whoredom is within them, and they do not know the Lord .
text_cn: 他们的行为不能使自己归向天主，因为邪淫的心神潜伏在他们内，致使他们不认识上主。

text_en: Israel’s pride testifies against him; Ephraim stumbles in his guilt; Judah also stumbles with them.
text_cn: 以色列的傲气呈现在他们脸上，厄弗辣因因自己的罪孽而跌倒，连犹大也与他们一同跌倒。

text_en: With their flocks and herds they shall go to seek the Lord , but they will not find him; he has withdrawn from them.
text_cn: 纵使他们牵羊带牛去寻求上主，但仍然寻不着，因为他早已远离了他们。

text_en: They have dealt faithlessly with the Lord ; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon shall devour them along with their fields.
text_cn: 他们背叛了上主，因此他们生了私生子。看，毁灭者必要并吞他们和他们的基业。

text_en: Blow the horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah. Sound the alarm at Beth-aven; look behind you, Benjamin!
text_cn: 你们要在基贝亚吹角，在辣玛吹号，在贝特阿文发出警报，本雅明便要惊惶失措。

text_en: Ephraim shall become a desolation in the day of punishment; among the tribes of Israel I declare what is sure.
text_cn: 在惩罚之日，厄弗辣因将变成一片荒凉；对以色列各支派，我要宣告一件实有的事。

text_en: The princes of Judah have become like those who remove the landmark; on them I will pour out my wrath like water.
text_cn: 犹大的首领行事好像是挪移地界的人，所以我要在他们身上发泄我的忿怒，有如倒水一样。

text_en: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, because he was determined to go after vanity.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因强硬蛮横，破坏了正义，因为他乐意随从“虚无”。

text_en: Therefore I am like maggots to Ephraim, and like rottenness to the house of Judah.
text_cn: 因此，我对厄弗辣因将像是一个蠹（dù）鱼，对犹大家将像是一个蛀虫。

text_en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to the great king. But he is not able to cure you or heal your wound.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因发现了自己的疾病，犹大看见了自己的创伤，厄弗辣因便去了亚述，犹大遣使往谒大王；可是他不能医治你们，也不能治愈你们身上的创伤。

text_en: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear and go away; I will carry off, and no one shall rescue.
text_cn: 因为我对厄弗辣因要像是一只狮子，对犹大家要像是一只壮狮；的确，我必撕碎，然后退去；我要把掠物带走，谁也不能挽救。

text_en: I will return again to my place until they acknowledge their guilt and seek my face. In their distress they will beg my favor:
text_cn: 我要去，要回到我的原处，直到他们受了罚，而寻求我的圣容为止。在他们遇到困苦时，他们必要寻求我：
